title: August 19, 2019 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
MONDAY, AUGUST 19, 2019 
CITY HALL MEDIA ROOM 
301 W. SECOND STREET, 
 AUSTIN, TX  
 
 
Press Conference 
 
1:30 PM 
Attend a press conference regarding improved access to abortion care in Austin.  
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
